title: Fix PluginObjectView split/popover navigation modes falling back to drawer
body:
Only drawer/modal navigation modes worked when clicking ListView rows. Split and popover modes silently fell back to rendering a drawer form because `formLayout` didn't map them, and no `NavigationOverlay` was rendered for those modes.

### PluginObjectView (`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`)

- **`formLayout` now maps `split` and `popover`** — previously both fell through to `layout` (default `'drawer'`)
- **Split mode** renders `NavigationOverlay` with `mainContent` wrapping the grid in a resizable side-by-side panel
- **Popover mode** renders `NavigationOverlay` in popover mode (Dialog fallback when no `popoverTrigger`)
- Extracted shared `handleOverlayOpenChange` callback to avoid inline duplication

```tsx
const formLayout = navigationConfig?.mode === 'modal' ? 'modal'
  : navigationConfig?.mode === 'drawer' ? 'drawer'
  : navigationConfig?.mode === 'split' ? 'split'       // ← new
  : navigationConfig?.mode === 'popover' ? 'popover'   // ← new
  : layout;
```

### Console ObjectView (`apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx`)

- `onNavigate` now explicitly checks `action === 'view'` for page mode instead of relying on implicit fallthrough after the `'new_window'` guard

### Tests

- Split test now asserts `Close panel` button from `NavigationOverlay`
- Popover test now asserts `dialog` role from the Dialog fallback
- New test: split panel close resets to normal grid view

### ROADMAP

- Added bug fix entry documenting root cause and resolution

>

> 
> ## 最终目标
> 所有正式支持的行导航模式（drawer、modal、page、new_window、split、popover），点击列表行后都能正确弹窗、跳转或打开新窗口，表现与规范一致。

> ## 详细修复点与检查清单
> 
> ### 1. page 模式无效
> - [ ] Console 的 onNavigate 回调在 mode: 'view' 时未实现，应导航到 `/apps/:appName/:objectName/record/:recordId`
> - [ ] 必须修复 onNavigate 支持 mode 为 view 时的跳转逻辑
> - [ ] 单测：page 模式点击后能正常路由到详情页
> 
> ### 2. new_window 模式无效
> - [ ] useNavigationOverlay 新窗口跳转 URL 必须符合 Console 路由 (`/apps/:appName/:objectName/record/:recordId`)，不是 `/:objectName/:recordId`
> - [ ] 或统一用 onNavigate 让应用层决定跳转方式
> - [ ] 单测：new_window 下��开新标签页能展示正确数据
> 
> ### 3. split 模式无效
> - [ ] NavigationOverlay 需要 mainContent props，Console 需提供 mainContent，且点击行时 split 能展开详情
> - [ ] PluginView 内 handleRowClick 需支持 split 并正确切换 overlay 状态
> - [ ] 单测：split 状态下能够分栏浏览详情
> 
> ### 4. popover 模式无效
> - [ ] 传递 popoverTrigger，确保点击能弹出定位正确的卡片预览
> - [ ] 单测：popover 能悬浮预览详情信息
> 
> ### 5. PluginView 代码需补充 split、popover 分支
> - [ ] handleRowClick 要有 split、popover 直接调用 overlay 控制
> - [ ] 其他层级 handleClick 需同步
> 
> ### 6. 通用 & 验收
> - [ ] 所有导航模式回归测试（自动化/手工）
> - [ ] 修复后运行所有 test，无回归/新增用例全过
> - [ ] 更新 Roadmap 文档，补充导航模式说明
